svg.title: Many possible explanations, one actual heavy marble
svg.desc: A 32 by 32 grid shows all 1,024 possible heavy-marble locations. Three cards show alternative explanations: marble 1 is heavy, marble 2 is heavy, or marble 1,024 is heavy. In each explanation all other marbles are normal. Exactly one explanation is true; each has prior probability 1/1,024. Ellipses omit intermediate marble labels on the cards.

g.text: Many possible explanations, one actual heavy marble
Each dot is one candidate location.
Exactly one possibility is true. Before testing,
